scope: Sanitized architecture reasoning; no live connection or deployment.

cases.title: Define grain, population and bounded read scope
cases.input_contract: Synthetic export_id demo-2026, unique event_id, at most 5000 rows, approved columns event_id, cents, price, event_time, note.
cases.expected: One row per event_id within one immutable export_id;at most 5000 rows and no unbounded collect.
cases.verification: Write the row-grain and population contract, plus the count/uniqueness/readback checks that would reject an oversized or duplicate export.

cases.title: Map four tricky SQL values without losing meaning
cases.expected: LongType 125;DecimalType(10,2)12345678.90;the same instant rendered 19:00:00UTC under the baseline;NULL remains missing, not an empty string.
cases.verification: State source and target type, unit, precision/timezone policy and one rejected conversion for each.

cases.title: Reject the lowerBound/upperBound filter misconception
cases.input_contract: IDs[-10,0,5,10,99, NULL]. Illustrative partition predicates:id<5 OR id IS NULL, and id>=5.
cases.expected: All 6 supplied rows can be read. Bounds choose partition stride, not a WHERE filter restricting IDs to[0,10).
cases.verification: Assign each supplied ID to the two predicates and write an explicit SQL filter for the intended population if one is required.

cases.title: Bound connection concurrency and read consistency
cases.input_contract: Two JDBC partitions;source rows can change;no live snapshot-coordination adapter is provided.
cases.expected: A nominal 2-partition connection bound plus an explicit immutable-export or separately qualified coordinated-snapshot strategy.
cases.verification: Name connection/time/fetch controls and show how concurrent source updates would otherwise produce a mixed-time result.

cases.title: Remove credentials from source and evidence
cases.expected: No password, user, URL or credential-bearing connection string in the saved source/evidence;only approved operational settings are retained.
cases.verification: Write the exact sanitized object and identify the approved runtime credential source without inventing a real account.

cases.title: Write a future acceptance and failure contract
cases.input_contract: Current profile bundles no qualified JDBC driver/remote database;synthetic export and schema mapping only. Optional enrichment IDssql-quality-01 and sql-test-01.
cases.expected: A reviewable acceptance matrix with unavailable runtime rows, not a fabricated successful connection.
cases.verification: List positive and negative cases, exact version tuple, source identity, output oracle, connection closure and no-write privileges.

golden.provenance: synthetic export and proposal;no connection opened
golden.snapshot_strategy: immutable export;live coordinated snapshot adapter unavailable
